_doc: Render massing for the Groeningemonument (1906, Groeningepark), read by pipeline/src/scene.ts. GRB KNW 27592 is the 8.2 m octagonal plinth, rendered as an 8 m brick 'house'. Metres in Lambert 72 around 'anchor' (centre of the footprint), u along 'axis_deg' (a footprint edge). Look from Commons photos (refs/) and the photo Tom shared: a low stepped grey stone base, a grey stone pedestal with bronze-grey relief groups against its sides, the gilded Maiden of Flanders with a lion on top holding a spear up. DHMV II is too coarse for the statue (p95 8.1 m); heights are estimated from the photos: base 1.2 m, pedestal 6.5 m, statue to 10.5 m, spear tip 13 m. Parts cannot start in mid-air, so the statue and spear rise from the ground inside the pedestal.

parts.id: gilded statue (Maiden of Flanders with lion)
